title: Next increment — exact occurrence-level, bitemporal provenance
summary: Introduce a new immutable-ish, evidence-only edge identity anchored to source unit revision and exact claim/quotation span, not only source ID; support multiple parents and per-edge valid/observed time plus supersession/retraction without deleting history. Use Single Time Service authority for temporal comparison. Provide a deterministic snapshot graph before using dependency groups in comparative positioning. Keep the existing dev8 graph as an experimental adapter, not as an authoritative truth engine.
invariants: Define source edition and occurrence identifiers before designing graph edge dispatch.
Prove that historical as-of graph queries are insertion-order invariant for equivalent eligible evidence.
Retractions of provenance links must not imply falsity of the source claim.
Extend admission tests with contradictory evidence, multiple parents, deduplicated syndication, cross-span quotations, publication vs observation cutoffs and source replacement.
Retain old artifacts and qualification receipts; do not silently promote experimental head to production.

provenance.claim: Dev8 structure and known absence of temporal/occurrence dimensions.
